scope: App-server client: one-shot review and isolated edit through vibe-app-server 2.26.1, one process per run; one active run per owning server/storage instance; five MCP tools; restart does not resume or replay work. There is one engine and no backend selector or backend config key. Around the five tools: optional frozen acceptance contracts checked against the exact exported patch, append-only coordinator assessments, sanitized run reports, a version-matched preparation pass that gates ordinary dispatch, and owned validation copies.
